notes: Covers all 296 North American N64 releases plus key PAL/Japan exclusives. Game codes follow Nintendo's NUS-XXXX-YYY format (XX=title abbreviation, Y=region: E=USA, J=Japan, P=PAL, A=Australia). CRC1 values sourced from the No-Intro verified ROM set where available.

games.title: 1080° Snowboarding
games.description: Nintendo's flagship snowboarding title puts you on the slopes of Mount Everest and five other mountains. Tight controls, detailed graphics, and a radical trick system made it the benchmark N64 sports game.

games.title: Aidyn Chronicles: The First Mage
games.description: An ambitious turn-based RPG with a sweeping fantasy story following Alaron, a young squire who discovers he's been poisoned by goblins and must find a cure while uncovering his true destiny.

games.title: Armorines: Project S.W.A.R.M.
games.description: A first-person shooter based on the comic book series. Soldiers battle an alien insectoid invasion across diverse environments from mines to military bases.

games.title: Army Men: Air Combat
games.description: Take to the skies in a helicopter as the plastic Green Army battles the evil Tan forces. Supports two-player co-op and features 20 missions across jungles, snow, and cities.

games.title: Army Men: Sarge's Heroes
games.description: Lead Sarge and his green plastic squad through living-room environments scaled to toy soldier size. Battle Tan forces across giant kitchens, bathtubs, and backyards in this third-person shooter.

games.title: Army Men: Sarge's Heroes 2
games.description: The sequel sends Sarge into a board game world. Features an improved control scheme, new weapons, and a full multiplayer mode.

games.title: Banjo-Kazooie
games.description: A charming bear-and-bird duo team up to rescue Banjo's sister Tooty from the wicked witch Gruntilda. Nine vibrant worlds stuffed with Jiggies, musical notes, and Rare's trademark irreverent humour.

games.title: Banjo-Tooie
games.description: The epic sequel features nine enormous interconnected worlds, split-apart bird-and-bear mechanics, and a first-person shooting mode. Battles the resurrected Gruntilda across a richly detailed world.

games.title: BattleTanx
games.description: Post-apocalyptic tank warfare across 16 levels of a ravaged America. Fight to protect your queen in an obsessive four-player multiplayer mode that kept it in college dorms for years.

games.title: BattleTanx: Global Assault
games.description: The sequel expands the tank mayhem worldwide, from San Francisco to Paris to Moscow. Adds new gangs, new tanks, and a beefed-up four-player mode.

games.title: Beetle Adventure Racing!
games.description: Race Volkswagen Beetles through gorgeous open-world-style tracks that reward exploration. Hidden shortcuts and crates full of power-ups made this a cult favourite.

games.title: Bio F.R.E.A.K.S.
games.description: A 3D fighting game set in a dystopian future featuring grotesque cybernetic warriors. Unique for its flight-based combat and gruesome fatality-style finishers.

games.title: Blast Corps
games.description: A runaway nuclear missile carrier must be guided to safety — by demolishing everything in its path. One of the most creative and explosively satisfying games on the N64.

games.title: Bomberman 64
games.description: Bomberman's first full 3D adventure. White Bomber battles the evil Altair across five worlds, with the series' signature multiplayer Battle Mode intact and as addictive as ever.

games.title: Bomberman 64: The Second Attack
games.description: The darker sequel has Bomberman battle the evil Rukifellth across six elemental worlds with new elemental bombs and a mysterious companion character, Pommy.

games.title: Bomberman Hero
games.description: A more action-focused Bomberman featuring flight and swimming sequences. White Bomber must rescue Princess Millian from the Garaden Empire.

games.title: Bottom of the 9th
games.description: An impressive early N64 baseball game featuring all 28 MLB teams. Known for its smooth 3D graphics and solid pitching/hitting mechanics.

games.title: Buck Bumble
games.description: Play as a bionic bee defending the garden from a mutant insect army. A flight combat game with an absolutely unforgettable eurobeat title theme.

games.title: Bust-A-Move '99
games.description: The classic bubble-shooting puzzle game comes to N64 with over 200 stages and a competitive two-player mode. Match coloured bubbles before they reach the bottom.

games.title: Castlevania
games.description: Reinhart Schneider and Carrie Fernandez journey to Dracula's castle in this landmark 3D Castlevania. Despite polarising opinions, it established the N64 3D adventure formula.

games.title: Castlevania: Legacy of Darkness
games.description: An expanded version of the original N64 Castlevania, adding werewolf Cornell as a playable character along with two new chapters and additional gameplay tweaks.

games.title: Chameleon Twist
games.description: A chameleon with an extraordinarily long tongue navigates five colourful worlds by grabbing, swallowing, and launching enemies. A quirky early N64 platformer.

games.title: Chopper Attack
games.description: An arcade-style helicopter shooter with bright, chunky graphics. Blast through 12 missions destroying tanks, planes, and gunboats.

games.title: Clay Fighter 63⅓
games.description: A fighting game featuring goofy claymation characters like Bad Mr. Frosty and Earthworm Jim. Known more for its bizarre humour than its depth, but a memorable rental.

games.title: Command & Conquer
games.description: The legendary real-time strategy game adapted for N64. Command GDI or Brotherhood of Nod forces in the battle over Tiberium resources, with a specially designed controller interface.

games.title: Conker's Bad Fur Day
games.description: The most adult game on the N64 — a hung-over squirrel battles through a surreal world packed with movie parodies, crude humour, and surprisingly emotional moments. A technical masterpiece.

games.title: Cruis'n Exotica
games.description: The third Cruis'n game takes the arcade racing series to exotic locations including jungles, Egypt, and alien worlds. Faster and more ludicrous than its predecessors.

games.title: Cruis'n USA
games.description: One of the N64's launch titles, porting the Midway arcade racer. Race across America's highways from San Francisco to Washington D.C. in this early showcase of N64 speed.

games.title: Cruis'n World
games.description: The Cruis'n series goes global with 14 international courses from China to Kenya. The best-playing entry in the series with improved physics and track variety.

games.title: Dark Rift
games.description: A 3D fighting game set in an apocalyptic future where warriors battle over a rift in space-time. Features unique characters and a surprisingly deep combo system for a launch-era fighter.

games.title: Destruction Derby 64
games.description: Wreck your way through demolition derbies and circuit races where causing damage is the point. Four-player split-screen demolition mode is the highlight.

games.title: Diddy Kong Racing
games.description: Race as Diddy Kong and friends across five worlds in karts, hovercrafts, and planes to defeat the intergalactic alien pig Wizpig. Features a full adventure mode with boss races.

games.title: Donkey Kong 64
games.description: Five playable Kongs traverse eight enormous worlds collecting bananas, golden bananas, and battle coins to stop King K. Rool's Blast-O-Matic machine from destroying DK Island.

games.title: Donald Duck: Goin' Quackers
games.description: Donald Duck chases the villainous Merlock through four themed worlds to rescue Daisy. A competent if short platformer enhanced by Ubisoft's excellent N64 engine.

games.title: Doom 64
games.description: Not a port but an entirely new Doom game built for N64. Features new monsters, darker atmosphere, and a haunting synth score by Aubrey Hodges. Now considered the best classic Doom.

games.title: Duke Nukem 64
games.description: The irreverent alien-blasting action hero comes to N64 in this modified port of Duke Nukem 3D. Features four-player deathmatch, though some PC content was toned down.

games.title: Duke Nukem: Zero Hour
games.description: An original Duke Nukem adventure with third-person and first-person sections across time periods from the Wild West to a post-apocalyptic future.

games.title: Earthworm Jim 3D
games.description: Jim travels through the fragmented sections of his own brain across five themed worlds. A divisive entry that struggled to translate the series' 2D charm into 3D.

games.title: Excitebike 64
games.description: A glorious update of the NES classic with realistic physics, multiple game modes, and a track editor. The best motocross game on N64, featuring 3D courses with elevation and mud effects.

games.title: Extreme-G
games.description: Blistering futuristic motorcycle racing at ludicrous speeds through twisting tube tracks. One of the fastest-feeling games on N64, with a thumping techno soundtrack.

games.title: Extreme-G 2
games.description: The sequel refines the insane speed of the original with better tracks, more bikes, and a deeper weapon system. Still one of the best racing games on the platform.

games.title: F-Zero X
games.description: Blindingly fast anti-gravity racing with 30 machines simultaneously on track. Runs at a rock-solid 60fps with a metal soundtrack and an X Cup random track generator.

games.title: GoldenEye 007
games.description: The game that defined console first-person shooters. Play as James Bond across 18 missions based on the film, with legendary four-player multiplayer that defined a generation.

games.title: Gauntlet Legends
games.description: The classic dungeon crawler fully realised in 3D with four-player co-op. Hack through hordes of enemies as a warrior, valkyrie, wizard, or elf.

games.title: Glover
games.description: Play as a sentient wizard's glove rolling crystal balls through six themed worlds. A charming and creative puzzle-platformer with surprisingly deep ball-rolling mechanics.

games.title: Goemon's Great Adventure
games.description: The quirky feudal Japan-set platformer brings Goemon and his friends to a two-player side-scrolling adventure across a surreal Japan filled with robots and aliens.

games.title: Harvest Moon 64
games.description: Restore your grandfather's farm by cultivating crops, raising livestock, and building relationships with the villagers. The N64 entry in the beloved farming sim series that captivated a generation.

games.title: Hybrid Heaven
games.description: A unique sci-fi RPG with real-time exploration and turn-based combat. Uncover a conspiracy involving alien-human hybrids beneath the United Nations building in New York.

games.title: Hydro Thunder
games.description: The arcade powerboat racer makes a near-perfect conversion. Race exotic speedboats through spectacular aquatic environments from flooded cities to Arctic ice flows.

games.title: Iggy's Reckin' Balls
games.description: Iguanas on balls race up towers by using grappling hooks to steal power-ups and knock each other around. An eccentric and surprisingly fun party racing game.

games.title: Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine
games.description: Indy ventures into Soviet-era Russia to investigate a Babylonian power source. A Tomb Raider-style action adventure that captures the film series' spirit well.

games.title: Jet Force Gemini
games.description: Three siblings battle the insectoid Mizar army across a vast galaxy in this third-person shooter. Features unique per-character abilities and an enormous, varied universe to explore.

games.title: Killer Instinct Gold
games.description: The definitive home version of the arcade fighting sensation with its iconic Ultra Combos. An N64 launch title featuring 10 fighters and a thumping hip-hop/metal soundtrack.

games.title: Kobe Bryant in NBA Courtside
games.description: Nintendo's own NBA game featuring Kobe Bryant on the cover. Praised for realistic player models, solid gameplay, and full NBA team/player rosters.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
games.description: Link must relive the same three days to stop the moon crashing into Termina. A darker, more emotional Zelda exploring themes of grief, transformation, and the passage of time.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.description: Travel through time in Hyrule as young Link to stop Ganondorf obtaining the Triforce. Widely considered one of the greatest video games ever made, pioneering 3D action-adventure.

games.title: Mario Kart 64
games.description: Race as Mario and friends across 16 courses from Mushroom Cup to Special Cup. The definitive N64 party racer with an iconic Battle Mode and beloved soundtrack.

games.title: Mario Golf
games.description: A charming golf game featuring Mario characters alongside original golfers. Camelot's careful approach to RPG-style character building set a new standard for sports games.

games.title: Mario Party
games.description: Nintendo's board game brawler where four players race across themed boards competing in 50 mini-games. Invented the party game genre and destroyed more friendships than any other N64 title.

games.title: Mario Party 2
games.description: The sequel refines the formula with themed costume boards, new mini-games, and the Duel Board mode. Generally considered the high point of the N64 Mario Party trilogy.

games.title: Mario Party 3
games.description: The final N64 Mario Party introduces duel maps and stamp collecting alongside the core board game. Features the largest mini-game collection of the trilogy.

games.title: Super Mario 64
games.description: The revolutionary 3D platformer that launched the Nintendo 64. Collect Power Stars across 15 worlds inside Peach's Castle to rescue the princess from Bowser.

games.title: Mario Tennis
games.description: A brilliant tennis game with tight controls, a diverse character roster, and an engaging RPG mode. Introduced Waluigi to the world and is still considered one of the best tennis games ever.

games.title: Mega Man 64
games.description: Mega Man Volnutt explores ruins and battles Reaverbots in this 3D action RPG. A port of Mega Man Legends, praised for its charming characters and exploration.

games.title: Mischief Makers
games.description: An ultra-fast 2D platformer with unique grab-and-shake mechanics. Marina Liteyears rescues Professor Theo from alien forces in this overlooked Treasure gem.

games.title: Mission: Impossible
games.description: A third-person stealth game based on the 1996 film featuring Ethan Hunt's gadgetry and disguises. One of the few good licensed N64 games with solid stealth mechanics.

games.title: Monaco Grand Prix
games.description: A realistic F1 racing simulation featuring official teams and drivers from the 1999 season. One of the better Formula 1 experiences on N64 with careful track recreation.

games.title: Mortal Kombat 4
games.description: The first 3D Mortal Kombat features weapons, 15 fighters, and the series' infamous Fatalities. Shinnok's invasion of Edenia provides the backdrop for bloody 3D kombat.

games.title: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
games.description: The ultimate MK compilation featuring characters from all three original games plus new additions. An early N64 showcase with the full roster of Shao Kahn's tournament.

games.title: WWF No Mercy
games.description: The pinnacle of N64 wrestling games and arguably the greatest wrestling game ever made. AKI's sublime grapple engine, a deep career mode, and full customisation of everything.

games.title: Ogre Battle 64: Person of Lordly Caliber
games.description: A deep tactical RPG/strategy hybrid where you command armies across a fantasy continent. Your moral choices affect unit alignment and determine one of multiple endings.

games.title: Paper Mario
games.description: Mario enters a storybook world to rescue the Star Rod from Bowser in this charming turn-based RPG. Seven partners, seven chapters, and a witty script make it one of the N64's finest.

games.title: Perfect Dark
games.description: Joanna Dark, a special agent, unravels a conspiracy involving alien technology and corporate espionage. GoldenEye's spiritual successor with deeper multiplayer, bots, and missions mode.

games.title: Pilotwings 64
games.description: An N64 launch title showcasing the hardware's power through hang gliding, rocketbelt, gyrocopter, and skydiving challenges across beautifully realised open environments.

games.title: Pokémon Snap
games.description: Professor Oak sends you on a photo safari through seven Pokémon habitats. Manipulate the environment to coax rare Pokémon poses for the highest score.

games.title: Pokémon Stadium
games.description: Bring your Game Boy Pokémon into full 3D battle arenas. Features a Gym Leader Castle, rental Pokémon, mini-games, and a Game Boy Tower for playing handheld games on the TV.

games.title: Pokémon Stadium 2
games.description: The sequel adds Gold/Silver Pokémon compatibility, more mini-games, and a deeper Gym Leader Castle. The definitive Stadium experience for the Johto generation.

games.title: Quest 64
games.description: Brian the mage searches for his missing father and the magic tome in N64's only original RPG at launch. A simple but charming adventure with a unique elemental magic combat system.

games.title: Quake
games.description: The landmark 3D shooter runs impressively on N64 with an exclusive soundtrack by Trent Reznor. Four-player split-screen deathmatch made it a dorm room staple.

games.title: Rayman 2: The Great Escape
games.description: Rayman battles the robotic pirates of Admiral Razorbeard across a stunning fantasy world. Gorgeous visuals, inventive levels, and a surprisingly emotional story.

games.title: Road Rash 64
games.description: Illegal street motorcycle racing with bats, chains, and police to dodge. The rough-and-tumble road combat racing series makes its N64 debut.

games.title: Rocket: Robot on Wheels
games.description: Sucker Punch's debut game features a physics-based robot navigating a theme park. Remarkably deep physics puzzles for 1999, a severely underrated gem.

games.title: San Francisco Rush: Extreme Racing
games.description: The Midway arcade racer makes it home with the series' signature secret shortcuts and stunt areas hidden across hilly San Francisco tracks.

games.title: San Francisco Rush 2049
games.description: Futuristic San Francisco racing with cars that can sprout wings for aerial stunts. The best Rush game, with beautifully designed tracks and a satisfying stunt mode.

games.title: Shadow Man
games.description: Mike LeRoi, possessed by a voodoo mask, battles serial killers in the realm of the dead. A dark, expansive adventure game with incredible atmosphere and an eerie soundtrack.

games.title: Snowboard Kids
games.description: Chibi-style children snowboard down cartoon mountains collecting coins and hurling items. A charming, chaotic kart-racing alternative that flies under most radars.

games.title: Snowboard Kids 2
games.description: The sequel expands the roster, courses, and items while keeping the chaotic charm. Better physics and a proper adventure mode elevate it above the original.

games.title: South Park
games.description: Cartman, Stan, Kyle, and Kenny shoot turkeys, cows, and government agents across South Park. The show's humour is intact but the game beneath it is thin.

games.title: Space Station: Silicon Valley
games.description: Evo, a microchip, possesses animal bodies to solve puzzles across a runaway space station. A brilliantly inventive puzzle-platformer from the creators of GTA.

games.title: Super Smash Bros.
games.description: Eight Nintendo icons battle on platforms in a unique fighting game where damage sends fighters flying. Invented the platform fighter genre and packed in enormous Nintendo nostalgia.

games.title: Superman 64
games.description: Infamously one of the worst games ever made. Superman flies through endless rings in a kryptonite-filled virtual Metropolis in what became a byword for licensed game disasters.

games.title: Tetrisphere
games.description: A unique twist on Tetris where blocks wrap around a sphere. Remove pieces to expose the sphere's core. An inventive puzzle game with a thumping electronic soundtrack.

games.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater
games.description: The game that made skateboarding cool. String tricks together in two-minute runs across eight iconic parks collecting S-K-A-T-E letters and hitting score goals.

games.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2
games.description: The sequel perfected the formula with manuals connecting tricks, create-a-skater, and create-a-park. Arguably the greatest sports game of its era.

games.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3
games.description: The final N64 release, and the last cartridge game published for the system. Revert allows endless combo chains across eight new parks.

games.title: Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!
games.description: Play as Buzz Lightyear rescuing Woody from the obsessive toy collector Al. Six 3D worlds based on the film with Pizza Planet tokens, battery collectibles, and boss fights.

games.title: Turok: Dinosaur Hunter
games.description: The N64 launch-era showpiece. Turok battles dinosaurs and lost tribe warriors to recover the Chronoscepter in lush, expansive jungle environments.

games.title: Turok 2: Seeds of Evil
games.description: A massive improvement over the original with diverse environments, incredible weapons like the Cerebral Bore, and intense enemy AI. One of N64's finest shooters.

games.title: Turok: Rage Wars
games.description: A standalone multiplayer-focused Turok with 10 arenas and 16 characters. Designed specifically for four-player deathmatch action.

games.title: Turok 3: Shadow of Oblivion
games.description: Two siblings — Joshua and Danielle Fireseed — battle the demon Oblivion across dark environments. Features two separate story campaigns with different abilities.

games.title: Wave Race 64
games.description: The stunning launch title showcased N64's water physics with jet ski racing on realistically undulating oceans. Still one of the best water-based racers ever made.

games.title: WinBack: Covert Operations
games.description: A military third-person shooter with cover mechanics years ahead of their time. Jean-Luc Cougar infiltrates a terrorist-controlled particle cannon installation.

games.title: WWF Attitude
games.description: The attitude era WWF roster captured in solid wrestling gameplay. Features create-a-wrestler and a full roster from Stone Cold to The Rock to Undertaker.

games.title: WWF WrestleMania 2000
games.description: The first AKI-developed THQ wrestling game, introducing the fluid grapple engine that would be perfected in No Mercy. Create-a-Pay-Per-View is a highlight.

games.title: WWF War Zone
games.description: The first Attitude-era WWF N64 game featuring motion-captured animations and create-a-wrestler mode. Rougher than AKI's games but solid for its time.

games.title: Yoshi's Story
games.description: Six Baby Yoshis journey through a storybook world to restore the Super Happy Tree. A short but gorgeous side-scroller with charming papercraft visuals.

games.title: Star Soldier: Vanishing Earth
games.description: A vertical shoot 'em up featuring 10 stages of intense alien combat. One of the few pure shooters on N64, with tight gameplay and multiple ship types.

games.title: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire
games.description: An N64 launch title following Dash Rendar's adventures between The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi. Features the iconic Hoth Battle of Echo Base opening.

games.title: Star Wars: Episode I Racer
games.description: Race podracers from the Phantom Menace across 25 circuits on 8 planets. Anakin's race in Mos Espa set the template for this addictive high-speed racer.

games.title: Star Wars: Rogue Squadron
games.description: Luke Skywalker and Rogue Squadron fly 16 missions across the Star Wars galaxy. Visually stunning for 1998 with an optional RAM expansion for improved graphics.

games.title: Star Wars: Battle for Naboo
games.description: A follow-up to Rogue Squadron set during The Phantom Menace conflict. Fly N-1 Starfighters, MTT transports, and STAP bikes across 15 missions.

games.title: Star Fox 64
games.description: Fox McCloud leads the Star Fox team against mad scientist Andross in this landmark rail shooter. Features branching paths, multiple endings, and four-player battle mode. DO A BARREL ROLL.

games.title: StarCraft 64
games.description: The legendary PC real-time strategy game adapted for N64 with co-op multiplayer. All three campaigns plus bonus missions, despite being an unlikely console port.

games.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
games.description: Based on the TV series, Hercules battles mythological monsters across ancient Greece. A passable beat-'em-up with limited depth but decent TV license execution.

games.title: Hey You, Pikachu!
games.description: Use the included VRU microphone to talk to Pikachu and guide him through activities. A novel concept showcasing N64's voice recognition, albeit with limited range.

games.title: California Speed
games.description: Arcade-style racing down California's highways in a modified version of the Cruisin' engine. Fast, fun, and unpretentious street racing with tight four-player action.

games.title: Rugrats: Scavenger Hunt
games.description: The Rugrats babies play board game-style mini-game competition. A Mario Party clone aimed squarely at younger audiences.

games.title: Scooby-Doo! Classic Creep Capers
games.description: Scooby and Shaggy solve mysteries across a haunted amusement park, hotel, and mansion. A serviceable adventure game well-suited to younger players.

games.title: Glover
games.description: A wizard's magical glove must recover six crystal balls transformed into toys. Creative level design and clever physics puzzles make this forgotten gem worth finding.

games.title: Virtual Chess 64
games.description: A fully-featured chess game with multiple computer difficulty settings and two-player mode. Clean 3D piece rendering and intuitive N64 controller interface.

games.title: Virtual Pool 64
games.description: A realistic billiards simulation with eight-ball, nine-ball, and trick shot modes. Surprisingly deep physics engine for a cart-based console billiards title.

games.title: Major League Baseball Featuring Ken Griffey Jr.
games.description: Full MLB rosters and stadiums in Nintendo's flagship baseball title. Excellent batting mechanics and a presentation that rivalled the actual broadcasts.

games.title: NFL Blitz
games.description: Seven-on-seven arcade football with late hits, no penalties, and turbo sprinting. One of the most purely fun multiplayer sports games on N64.

games.title: NFL Blitz 2000
games.description: The sequel adds new turbo moves, updated rosters, and a season mode. All the anarchic arcade football energy of the original, improved.

games.title: NFL Blitz 2001
games.description: Updated rosters, refined gameplay and extra plays keep the Blitz formula fresh. The definitive Blitz experience on N64.

games.title: NBA Showtime: NBA on NBC
games.description: Midway's NBA arcade follow-up with the NBC Sports presentation and two-on-two action. Faster and more explosive than any simulation basketball game.

games.title: NHL '99
games.description: Full NHL teams and players in EA's flagship hockey title. Refined controls and season mode make it the best N64 hockey game.

games.title: International Track & Field 2000
games.description: Button-mashing Olympic athletics across 10 events from sprinting to hammer throw. Four-player competition makes it a frantic party game.

games.title: Olympics: Sydney 2000
games.description: Official Sydney Olympics tie-in featuring 18 events from swimming to gymnastics. Konami's solid button-mashing sports template applied to the Summer Games.

games.title: Rally Challenge 2000
games.description: Off-road rally racing across dirt, mud, and gravel stages with licensed cars. A solid if unremarkable rally game with a good sense of speed.

games.title: Rampage 2: Universal Tour
games.description: Three monsters — George, Lizzie, and Ralph — demolish cities across America and beyond. Three-player simultaneous destruction is endlessly satisfying.

games.title: Rampage World Tour
games.description: Classic monster smashing updated for N64 with three simultaneous players. Knock out buildings, eat people, and avoid military retaliation across the globe.

games.title: Body Harvest
games.description: An early open-world concept from the creators of GTA. Battle alien Harvester invasions across five massive environments spanning decades from WW2 Greece to a futuristic America.

games.title: NBA In The Zone '98
games.description: Konami's full NBA simulation with all 29 teams and realistic season play. A solid basketball game that competed effectively with EA's NBA Live.

games.title: NBA Live 99
games.description: EA's flagship basketball simulation with full rosters, season play, and playoff mode. Realistic player ratings and fluid animations made it the go-to hoops game.

games.title: Shadowgate 64: Trials of the Four Towers
games.description: A 3D point-and-click adventure in the Shadowgate universe. Del Cottonwood explores a massive haunted castle, solving puzzles and battling monsters.

games.title: NFL QB Club '98
games.description: Licensed NFL football featuring John Elway and all 30 teams. Competed with Madden for the N64 simulation football crown.

games.title: Mike Piazza's StrikeZone
games.description: MLB baseball simulation featuring catcher Mike Piazza. Full season mode, all teams, and solid pitching/hitting gameplay.

games.title: Blues Brothers 2000
games.description: Jake and Elwood Blues platform-hop through a side-scrolling adventure based on the film sequel. Two-player co-op and a blues soundtrack are the highlights.

games.title: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
games.description: Terry McGinnis as Batman battles a returned Joker in Neo Gotham. A side-scrolling beat-'em-up based on the animated series.

games.title: Top Gear Overdrive
games.description: Realistic-ish circuit racing with licensed cars and a campaign mode. Four-player split-screen and a wide car selection stand out.

games.title: Top Gear Rally
games.description: A rally racing game featuring seven international circuits and detailed car damage. An early N64 showcase for weather effects and varied terrain.

games.title: AeroGauge
games.description: Futuristic hovercraft racing at extreme speed through five near-future tracks. Known for its stunning speed and challenging controls.

games.title: Lode Runner 3-D
games.description: The classic ladder-based puzzle game brought into three dimensions. Outsmart robots and dig trap holes across 56 brain-teasing levels.

games.title: Hybrid Heaven
games.description: Uncover a clone conspiracy under the UN building in this unique action/RPG hybrid. Real-time exploration switches to a turn-based limb-targeting combat system.

games.title: Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling
games.description: A solid bowling simulation with all the officially licensed Brunswick equipment. Spin mechanics, career mode, and four-player tournament play.

games.title: Jeremy McGrath Supercross 2000
games.description: Licensed supercross racing with Jeremy McGrath and fellow real AMA riders. Indoor stadium courses faithfully recreate the mud-spraying supercross circuit.

games.title: Starcraft 64
games.description: Blizzard's legendary RTS ported to N64 with all three campaigns. An impressive technical feat with exclusive co-op multiplayer missions.

games.title: Forsaken 64
games.description: A six-degrees-of-freedom shooter in the tradition of Descent. Hover-bike combat in zero-gravity post-apocalyptic environments.

games.title: Knockout Kings 2000
games.description: A realistic boxing simulation featuring real fighters including Evander Holyfield. Fluid punch animations and a career mode highlight this EA boxing title.

games.title: Rayman 2: The Great Escape
games.description: Rayman battles robot pirates in one of the N64's most beautiful platformers. Nine worlds of imaginative design and a surprisingly touching storyline.

games.title: Quake II
games.description: The sequel to Quake features deeper level design and a more cohesive mission structure. Four-player deathmatch and a solid single-player campaign.

games.title: Space Invaders
games.description: A 3D reimagining of the arcade classic with fully three-dimensional alien formations and multiple play modes updating the original concept.

games.title: Spider-Man
games.description: Web-slinging through New York City, Spidey battles Doctor Octopus, Venom, and Carnage. One of the best superhero games of its era with fluid movement and great boss fights.

games.title: Stunt Racer 64
games.description: Futuristic stunt track racing across loop-the-loops, corkscrews, and jumps. A creative racing game that rewards skill and showmanship equally.

games.title: Top Gear Hyperbike
games.description: Motorcycle racing across international circuits with 20 licensed bikes. Better physics and track variety than many N64 racing titles.

games.title: Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!
games.description: PAL version of the film tie-in platformer. Play as Buzz Lightyear to rescue Woody from toy collector Al across six 3D film-based worlds.

games.title: Silicon Valley
games.description: A tiny microchip called Evo possesses animals to solve puzzles and traverse a vast space station. Brilliant concept, inventive puzzles, and DMA's signature dark wit.

games.title: Iggy's Reckin' Balls
games.description: Iguanas race up towers on giant balls, using grappling hooks to zip around and knock rivals off. Unique physics-based racing that deserves more recognition.

games.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
games.description: An action game based on Spielberg's sequel featuring five dinosaur characters to play as and 24 missions across Isla Sorna's jungle environments.

games.title: All-Star Baseball '99
games.description: Full MLB rosters and stadiums in Acclaim's baseball series. Season mode, home run derby, and all 30 teams.

games.title: All-Star Baseball 2000
games.description: Updated rosters and improved batting physics in the third All-Star Baseball. Features a create-a-player and robust season simulation.

games.title: All-Star Baseball 2001
games.description: The final N64 entry in Acclaim's MLB series with the full 2001 roster. Refines the franchise formula with better AI and presentation.

games.title: AeroFighters Assault
games.description: A fast-paced 3D aerial combat game with six fighter jets. Battle alien aircraft in skies above multiple real-world locations.

games.title: Bass Masters Classic
games.description: A fishing simulation featuring professional bass tournament angling. Scout locations, select lures, and battle bass in multiple bodies of water.

games.title: International Superstar Soccer '98
games.description: Konami's acclaimed football simulation featuring 64 international teams. Fluid controls and solid commentary helped this rival FIFA on N64.

games.title: International Superstar Soccer 2000
games.description: Updated rosters and improved engine in Konami's football flagship. Considered by many the best football game on N64.

games.title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey
games.description: An N64 launch title featuring The Great One as host of arcade-style hockey. Fast, simplified gameplay made it an accessible launch day purchase.

games.title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
games.description: The improved sequel to the launch title with updated teams and better graphics. Full NHL simulation wrapped in arcade accessibility.

games.title: NASCAR 99
games.description: The official NASCAR simulation with real drivers, cars, and oval tracks. Drafting mechanics and full championship season mode.

games.title: NASCAR 2000
games.description: Updated drivers and refined handling in EA's NASCAR series. Introduces a damage model that affects car handling.

games.title: Madden NFL 99
games.description: The franchise NFL simulation comes to N64 with full rosters and John Madden commentary. Introduce the season and franchise mode that defined sports gaming.

games.title: Madden NFL 2000
games.description: Updated rosters and the new Madden Cards collecting system. The series' best N64 entry with improved AI and presentation.

games.title: Madden NFL 2001
games.description: Final N64 Madden with career mode improvements and full franchise management. Competes with NFL Blitz for the N64 football crown.

games.title: FIFA 98: Road to World Cup
games.description: EA's flagship football simulation featuring all World Cup qualifying nations. First FIFA to use the EAS engines later perfected across console generations.

games.title: FIFA 99
games.description: Full Premier League, Serie A, and European leagues in EA's football sim. Improved player physics and an enhanced season mode.

games.title: FIFA 2000
games.description: Updated kits, rosters, and the new indoor football mode. EA's continuing domination of N64 football.

games.title: NHL Breakaway '98
games.description: Arcade-leaning NHL hockey with all teams and players. Hits harder and scores more freely than simulation hockey titles.

games.title: NHL Blades of Steel '99
games.description: Konami's classic hockey franchise updated for N64. Fluid skating, hard checks, and spontaneous fights.

games.title: ISS Pro Evolution
games.description: The deeper, more realistic side of Konami's football lineup. Considered the best pure football sim on N64.

games.title: Hot Wheels Turbo Racing
games.description: Race officially licensed Hot Wheels cars on outrageous loop-filled tracks. Stunt sequences, four-player races, and a huge car roster.

games.title: Lego Racers
games.description: Race Lego brick cars on buildable tracks and collect new bricks by winning. A charming kart racer with genuine Lego customisation.

games.title: Monster Truck Madness 64
games.description: Enormous trucks compete in races, destruction derbies, and drag races. Four-player monster truck mayhem on destructible terrain.

games.title: WipeOut 64
games.description: The iconic futuristic anti-gravity racer comes to N64 with new tracks. Blazing speeds, weapon pickups, and the series' signature techno soundtrack.

games.title: Twisted Edge Extreme Snowboarding
games.description: Realistic snowboarding down open mountain courses with a trick system. Compete in slalom, halfpipe, and free-riding events.

games.title: Elmo's Letter Adventure
games.description: Sesame Street's Elmo helps young children learn the alphabet through mini-games. Designed for toddlers with large text and very simple controls.

games.title: Flying Dragon
games.description: Two fighting modes — a 3D virtual fighter and a 2D RPG board game mode. An unusual hybrid combining tournament fighting with strategic board game elements.

games.title: Mace: The Dark Age
games.description: Medieval weapons-based 3D fighting game with eight characters. Brutal combat featuring axes, maces, and swords in Gothic arenas.

games.title: Gex 64: Enter the Gecko
games.description: A wise-cracking gecko fights through TV show parody worlds. Collects remotes to unlock new levels, with sharp writing and tight platforming.

games.title: Gex 3: Deep Cover Gecko
games.description: Gex returns for a third adventure spoofing spy movies across TV-themed worlds. More refined than its predecessor with better camera control.

games.title: Fighting Force 64
games.description: A 3D beat-'em-up with four playable characters battling through urban environments. Two-player co-op brawling in the tradition of Streets of Rage.

games.title: Carmageddon 64
games.description: The infamously violent vehicular carnage game adapted for N64. Race or destroy competitors and pedestrians across post-apocalyptic arenas.

games.title: Fighter's Destiny
games.description: A 3D fighter where points are scored by specific takedowns rather than a health bar. A unique points-based system and tight controls set it apart.

games.title: Fighter's Destiny 2
games.description: The sequel expands the roster and adds new stages to the points-based fighter. More balanced than the original with improved animation.

games.title: Excitebike 64
games.description: Nintendo's definitive motocross game with a track editor and realistic mud physics. Six game modes and a ghost data system add enormous replay value.

games.title: Dr. Mario 64
games.description: The puzzle classic updated for N64 with story mode, multiplayer, and Dr. Wario. The definitive version of the virus-busting formula.

games.title: CyberTiger
games.description: A futuristic arcade golf game featuring a computer-generated Tiger Woods lookalike. Power-ups and over-the-top courses distinguish it from EA's realistic golf titles.

games.title: Golden Nugget 64
games.description: A full casino simulation with slots, poker, blackjack, and roulette. One of very few casino games on the platform, featuring an N64-specific card interface.

games.title: South Park: Chef's Luv Shack
games.description: Chef hosts a game show where South Park characters compete in mini-games and trivia. Raunchy humour and decent party gameplay.

games.title: South Park Rally
games.description: South Park characters race on courses set around the mountain town. Items, shortcuts, and all four boys playable in a kart-style racer.

games.title: Harvest Moon 64
games.description: Restore your grandfather's farm by growing crops, raising animals, and wooing villagers. Beloved for its relaxing pace and satisfying progression loop.

games.title: Ogre Battle 64: Person of Lordly Caliber
games.description: Command armies across a fantasy continent in a real-time strategy RPG. Alignment system reacts to your moral choices, shaping the story and unit powers.

games.title: Mia Hamm Soccer 64
games.description: An accessible soccer game featuring legendary US player Mia Hamm. Aimed at a family audience with simple controls and pick-up-and-play gameplay.

games.title: Space Station Silicon Valley
games.description: A microchip possesses animal bodies to navigate a runaway space station-turned-zoo. Brilliantly inventive puzzles and DMA's characteristic dark comedy.

games.title: SimCity 2000
games.description: Build and manage a thriving metropolis in Maxis's classic city simulation. The full SimCity 2000 experience adapted for the N64 controller.

games.title: Paperboy
games.description: The arcade classic reinvented in 3D for N64. Deliver papers and cause havoc across a neighbourhood full of hazards, all while hitting targets for bonus points.

games.title: Ms. Pac-Man: Maze Madness
games.description: Ms. Pac-Man explores 3D mazes collecting fruits and power pellets. An isometric adventure with new puzzle mechanics beyond the arcade original.

games.title: Armorines: Project S.W.A.R.M.
games.description: Elite soldiers battle a vast alien insect invasion across military facilities and jungles. Technically impressive enemy AI with enormous swarms attacking simultaneously.

games.title: Vigilante 8
games.description: Vehicle combat set in a 1970s conspiracy involving OPEC and government cover-ups. Four-player vehicular mayhem with multiple game modes and a surprising story.

games.title: Vigilante 8: 2nd Offense
games.description: The sequel expands the roster, adds new vehicles, and refines the battle mechanics. The definitive vehicular combat game on N64.

games.title: Shadow Man
games.description: Michael LeRoi crosses between the living world and Deadside to battle five serial killers. A dark, atmospheric action adventure with an enormous world to explore.

games.title: Resident Evil 2
games.description: The full Resident Evil 2 experience on N64 — Leon and Claire survive a zombie outbreak in Raccoon City. An incredible technical achievement for a cartridge port.

games.title: Bio F.R.E.A.K.S.
games.description: Cyberpunk fighters clash in the air in this unique 3D fighting game. Flight mechanics and grotesque designs set it apart from other N64 fighters.

games.title: Quake 64
games.description: id Software's landmark 3D shooter runs on N64 with a moody soundtrack. Dark gothic environments and fast, punishing gameplay.

games.title: Hexen
games.description: A dark fantasy FPS set in a world of demons and sorcery. Choose from Warrior, Mage, or Cleric across multiple interconnected hubs.

games.title: Wetrix
games.description: Build walls to trap falling water droplets before your lake overflows. An addictive and completely original puzzle concept.

games.title: Power Rangers: Lightspeed Rescue
games.description: Play as five Power Rangers battling Demon Queen Bansheera's forces. Isometric action game based on the Lightspeed Rescue TV series.

games.title: WCW vs. nWo: World Tour
games.description: AKI's first N64 wrestling game introducing the legendary grapple engine. A massive roster of WCW and nWo stars across a full championship circuit.

games.title: WCW/nWo Revenge
games.description: AKI's improved wrestling engine with 60+ WCW wrestlers and a career mode. The first great N64 wrestling game, selling millions as a must-own title.

games.title: WCW Mayhem
games.description: EA's wrestling answer to THQ with full WCW roster and PPV presentation. Different gameplay feel from AKI's titles but solid in its own right.

games.title: WCW Backstage Assault
games.description: WCW wrestling moves entirely to backstage environments — locker rooms, parking lots, kitchens. The last WCW-licensed game before the WWF purchased the company.

games.title: WinBack: Covert Operations
games.description: A tactical third-person shooter with cover-based combat mechanics years ahead of their time. Jean-Luc Cougar must take back a particle cannon from terrorists.

games.title: Duck Dodgers Starring Daffy Duck
games.description: Daffy Duck as Duck Dodgers zooms through space collecting Illudium-Q Element. A decent 3D platformer boosted by authentic Looney Tunes voice acting.

games.title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
games.description: Rugrats babies visit Euro-Reptarland theme park in Paris, based on the movie. Multiple mini-games and a brief adventure mode for younger players.

games.title: Batman of the Future: Return of the Joker
games.description: Terry McGinnis dons the bat-suit to battle the Joker in Neo Gotham. A side-scrolling beat-'em-up with flying sections from the animated series.

games.title: Midway's Greatest Arcade Hits Vol. 1
games.description: A collection of classic Midway arcade games including Defender, Joust, and Robotron 2084. Excellent emulation quality and a must-have for retro arcade fans.

games.title: Midway's Greatest Arcade Hits Vol. 2
games.description: The second collection adds Spy Hunter, Moon Patrol, and Tron. More classics faithfully preserved on cartridge.

games.title: Charlie Blast's Territory
games.description: Guide Charlie the demolitions expert through 50+ puzzle levels by blasting routes. An inventive bomb-placement puzzle game requiring careful planning.

games.title: AeroGauge
games.description: Futuristic hovercraft racing through tight tunnel courses at blistering speed. A technically accomplished early racer with a solid sense of velocity.

games.title: Shadowgate 64: Trials of the Four Towers
games.description: Del Cottonwood explores Shadowgate Castle in full 3D, solving puzzles and fighting monsters. The beloved point-and-click franchise reborn in three dimensions.

games.title: Lode Runner 3-D
games.description: The ladder-and-trap classic brought into 3D with fully rotatable levels. Brain-teasing puzzle design across 56 stages with a level editor.

games.title: Bust-A-Move 3 DX
games.description: Over 200 bubble-matching stages with a competitive versus mode. The most content-rich Bust-A-Move on N64.

games.title: Q*bert 64
games.description: The classic pyramid-hopping game updated with 3D graphics and new cube-based levels. Nostalgic gameplay updated for a new console generation.

games.title: Penny Racers
games.description: Cartoonish car racing where coins collected boost your vehicle's performance. Playful, arcade-style racing aimed at younger players.

games.title: International Track & Field: Summer Games
games.description: Button-mashing Olympic athletics across sprinting, swimming, and field events. Four-player competition is the main draw.

games.title: F-1 World Grand Prix
games.description: A realistic Formula 1 simulation with all 16 F1 circuits and official teams. The expansion pak upgrade significantly improves the visuals.

games.title: F-1 World Grand Prix II
games.description: The improved sequel features better AI, all 1998 teams, and expanded replay options. One of the most accurate F1 experiences on the platform.

games.title: Harvest Moon 64
games.description: Farm sim where you plant crops, raise animals, and build relationships in a rural village. A deeply relaxing and surprisingly rich simulation with multiple marriage candidates.

games.title: Killer Instinct Gold
games.description: An N64 launch title boasting 10 playable characters and the series' iconic Ultra Combos. The best home version of the 1994 arcade sensation.

games.title: NFL Quarterback Club 2002
games.description: The final N64 entry in Acclaim's NFL series with the full 2002 roster. Franchise mode improvements and better play-calling AI.

games.title: ECW Hardcore Revolution
games.description: The extreme wrestling promotion's bloody brawls captured in game form. Full ECW roster with hardcore weapons matches and tables.

games.title: Nagano Winter Olympics '98
games.description: Official Nagano Games tie-in covering 10 winter sports events. Biathlon, luge, ski jump, and more in four-player Olympic competition.

games.title: Sydney 2000
games.description: Official Sydney Olympics game with 18 events from 100m sprinting to pole vault. Button-mashing competitions work well in a party setting.

games.title: Duke Nukem: Zero Hour
games.description: Duke battles alien invaders across multiple time periods in third-person action sections. Features four-player deathmatch and Duke's classic irreverent attitude.

games.title: Top Gear Overdrive
games.description: Realistic circuit racing with licensed cars and a full championship season. Better handling model than many N64 racers, with excellent four-player split-screen.

games.title: Coaster Works
games.description: Design and ride your own roller coasters, adjusting every loop and drop. One of the few creative construction simulations on N64.

games.title: San Francisco Rush
games.description: Arcade-style street racing through San Francisco's hills with hidden shortcuts everywhere. The secret areas and stunt jumps give incredible replay value.

games.title: Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine
games.description: Indy ventures to Soviet Russia to prevent the completion of a Babylonian machine. Third-person action with puzzles, traps, and artifact collecting.

games.title: Army Men: Air Combat
games.description: Helicopter combat missions against the evil Tan Army. Co-op supported with 20 unique missions across jungle and desert environments.

games.title: Army Men: Sarge's Heroes
games.description: Third-person action with plastic soldiers battling across living rooms and backyards. The toy soldier aesthetic is charming, the gameplay solidly entertaining.

games.title: Jeopardy!
games.description: The famous TV quiz show on N64 with accurate Daily Double and Final Jeopardy rounds. Question bank covers history, science, pop culture, and more.

games.title: Wheel of Fortune
games.description: The classic letter-guessing TV game show on N64. Spin the wheel, buy vowels, and solve the puzzle before your opponents.

games.title: Clay Fighter: Sculptor's Cut
games.description: A Blockbuster-exclusive variant of Clay Fighter 63⅓ with extra characters including Boogerman and Earthworm Jim. The most complete Clay Fighter.

games.title: Mace: The Dark Age
games.description: Eight warriors clash with medieval weapons across an age of brutal magic. One of the more distinctive N64 fighters with a dark fantasy aesthetic.

games.title: NBA Courtside 2: Featuring Kobe Bryant
games.description: Nintendo's follow-up NBA title with deeper franchise mode and more accurate player ratings. Kobe Bryant features prominently in marketing and gameplay.

games.title: Jeremy McGrath Supercross '98
games.description: The first supercross game on N64 featuring real AMA riders and circuits. Dirt spray, realistic mud deformation, and stadium atmosphere.

games.title: Star Wars: Demolition
games.description: Vehicular combat across Star Wars locations featuring diverse fighters and bounty hunters. Jabba the Hutt hosts tournaments of explosive vehicle destruction.

games.title: Earthworm Jim 3D
games.description: Jim must navigate his own fragmented psyche across five themed brain worlds. Shiny attempts to translate the series' manic energy to 3D.

games.title: Vigilante 8
games.description: 1970s vehicle combat conspiracy involving oil shortages and government cover-ups. Destructible environments and a cast of unique vehicular warriors.

games.title: Battlezone: Rise of the Black Dogs
games.description: Cold War sci-fi tank combat based on the arcade classic updated for N64. Command hovering tank units across an alternate history cold war conflict.

games.title: Power Shovel
games.description: Operate a construction excavator through digging missions and challenges. An unusual simulation game with surprisingly precise and satisfying controls.

games.title: Coaster Works
games.description: Design roller coasters and ride them in first-person. One of the only creative theme park construction games on N64.

games.title: Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling 2
games.description: The sequel adds new bowling alleys, ball types, and a deeper career mode. Improved spin and oil physics make it the definitive N64 bowling game.

games.title: Freestyle Motocross: McGrath vs. Pastrana
games.description: Jeremy McGrath and Travis Pastrana face off in trick-based freestyle motocross. Stunt competitions across purpose-built arenas.

games.title: Yogi Bear: Yogi's Gold Rush
games.description: Yogi Bear explores Jellystone Park collecting Ranger Smith's stolen gold. A simple platformer based on the Hanna-Barbera cartoon.

games.title: Turok: Rage Wars
games.description: A standalone multiplayer arena shooter in the Turok universe. Ten arenas and 16 characters designed purely for competitive four-player action.

games.title: Scooby-Doo! Classic Creep Capers
games.description: Scooby and Shaggy unmask villains across a haunted house, hotel, and fairground. Simple adventure gameplay targeting younger N64 owners.

games.title: Virtual Chess 64
games.description: A full-featured chess game with attractive 3D pieces and multiple AI difficulty levels. One of the better chess implementations on any N64 game.

games.title: Ken Griffey Jr.'s Slugfest
games.description: The follow-up to Ken Griffey Jr. Presents featuring updated rosters and improved stadiums. One of Nintendo's flagship sports titles on N64.

games.title: Sesame Street: Sport Edition
games.description: Elmo and friends compete in Olympic-style mini-sports games. Designed for young children with simplified controls and friendly characters.

games.title: Racing Simulation 2
games.description: A serious European touring car racing simulation with realistic handling. Tight cornering physics and a broad selection of licensed cars.

games.title: Monaco Grand Prix Racing Simulation 2
games.description: An improved F1 simulation with all Monaco circuit detail and realistic physics. Weather effects and tyre wear add strategic depth.

games.title: Ogre Battle 64
games.description: A sprawling tactical RPG where your moral decisions affect your armies and ending. Deep strategy wrapped in a compelling political fantasy narrative.

games.title: Hybrid Heaven
games.description: Sci-fi action RPG with turn-based limb-targeting combat under the United Nations. Unique grappling mechanic and moody atmosphere.

games.title: ECW Anarchy Rulz
games.description: The second ECW wrestling game on N64 with an expanded roster and bloodier matches. Hardcore tables, ladders, and weapons matches throughout.

games.title: Xena: Warrior Princess: The Talisman of Fate
games.description: The TV warrior princess battles in a 3D fighter with eight mythological characters. Four-player support and decent character variety.

games.title: Command & Conquer
games.description: The legendary RTS adapted for console with a custom N64 interface. Play both GDI and Brotherhood of Nod campaigns from the original PC classic.

games.title: Micro Machines 64 Turbo
games.description: Tiny cars race across giant household environments — desks, gardens, and kitchens. The N64 entry in the beloved Micro Machines franchise.

games.title: Cyber Tiger
games.description: Futuristic golf with a digital Tiger Woods lookalike and power-up courses. Casual and arcadey compared to EA's serious golf simulation titles.

games.title: Pac-Man World
games.description: Pac-Man's 20th anniversary adventure sees him running, rolling, and butt-bouncing through 3D stages. A solid celebration of the icon with inventive level design.

games.title: Striker Pro 2000
games.description: A fast-paced football simulation with an arcade lean and solid multiplayer. Competes with FIFA and ISS for the N64 football market.

games.title: Road Rash 64
games.description: Illegal motorcycle street racing with chains, bats, and police helicopter pursuit. Four-player split-screen anarchy on open-world tracks.

games.title: Blues Brothers 2000
games.description: Jake and Elwood Blues platform across the US to reconstruct their band. Two-player simultaneous play and authentic Blues Brothers licensing.

games.title: Laser Invaders
games.description: A Space Invaders-inspired shooter with modern N64 graphics and multiple game modes. One of the last-ever N64 releases, known only to dedicated collectors.

games.title: 40 Winks
games.description: A cancelled N64 platformer where twins battle nightmare creatures in a dream world. Finally officially released in 2018, nearly 20 years after its development.

games.title: Elmo's Number Journey
games.description: Sesame Street's Elmo helps young children learn numbers through interactive mini-games. Companion to Elmo's Letter Adventure for early learners.

games.title: Rakuga Kids
games.description: PAL-exclusive fighting game where children battle using drawings that come to life. A charming concept with solid fighting mechanics and colourful character designs.

games.title: Knife Edge: Nose Gunner
games.description: A behind-the-ship rail shooter from the tail-gunner perspective. PAL exclusive with intense bullet-dodging gameplay and boss encounters.

games.title: Excitebike 64
games.description: PAL release of Nintendo's definitive motocross game with physics-based riding. Track editor and ghost data add considerable replay value.

games.title: Super Mario 64
games.description: The original Japanese launch version of the revolutionary 3D platformer. Features slightly different text and some pre-localisation content.

games.title: F-Zero X
games.description: Japanese version of the blindingly fast anti-gravity racer. Identical gameplay with Japanese text and slightly different title screen presentation.

games.title: Goemon 64
games.description: Mystical Ninja Starring Goemon's Japanese counterpart, featuring Goemon and Ebisumaru in their first fully 3D adventure through a bizarre modern Japan.

games.title: Pokémon Stadium (Japan)
games.description: The original Japanese Pokémon Stadium predating the Western release, featuring 40 Pokémon battling in 3D arenas — simpler than the later international version.
